title: Multi-Site Health Summary count scope
red: SiteHealthSummaryCountScopeContractTests initially could not compile because the count-scope classifier did not exist.
focusedTests: 20/20 passed across the Multi-Site Health Summary regression set, including count scope, truncation, enabled-Site scope, bounded paging, fallback, alert counts, Browser, and Desktop contracts
implementation: The summary API now exposes countsScope as all-enabled-sites or returned-sites. Browser and Desktop explicitly explain that alert totals are limited to displayed Sites when the bounded summary is truncated, while retaining the bounded query for predictable cost.
boundary: This module makes the bounded-page scope explicit; it does not add an expensive unbounded global alert aggregation query. Authenticated visual published-EXE smoke, PostgreSQL-backed live integration, Authenticode signing, hosted CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, and production certification remain outside this verification run.
